fields.meaning: Stroke width recorded as 0 — hairline rendering, consistent across all 25 DT regions

fields.normalizedValue: no explicit RGB colour object attached
fields.meaning: No explicit colour was assigned in the stroke path record. The rendering engine applies its default ink colour (black). rgbnone means "no colour object was present", NOT "colour data was discarded"
No fill operation is present in the PDF operator stream. All strokes are unfilled. This is the known door drawing convention in CODE_06
No clipping path is active. Strokes render in page coordinate space directly

overallConclusion: The sw0|rgbnone|f0|c0 descriptor captures a uniform stroke-only door convention. rgbnone means "no colour object attached — default black ink used", NOT "colour was missing from rendering". The convention is identical across all 25 DT regions — a deliberate stylized drawing convention, not a capture bug or normalization fallback.
